Osmania University, Hyderabad, India | 2021

Coursework: C, Java, Python, SQL Programming, and Data Structures

## Work Experience

### Data Analyst
**Cognizant Information Technology Company**, Hyderabad, India | 09/2023 – 11/2024

• Analysed 500K+ structured records (transactional and customer data) using SQL and Python, along with unstructured feedback data (support tickets and survey responses) to identify customer churn patterns and operational gaps.

• Performed data cleaning and preprocessing on datasets with 10–15% missing or inconsistent values, improving reporting accuracy by 25% through validation rules and transformation scripts.

• Built interactive dashboards in Power BI/Tableau to monitor KPIs such as revenue growth, SLA compliance, customer retention rate, and ticket resolution time, enabling leadership to track performance in real time.

• Applied statistical analysis and predictive modelling (regression, trend forecasting) to identify seasonal sales trends and predict demand fluctuations, improving quarterly forecasting accuracy by 20%.

• Collaborated with business stakeholders across operations and finance teams to gather reporting requirements and translated them into automated SQL queries and Python scripts, reducing manual reporting effort by 30%.

• Implemented data validation checks and quality control processes, reducing duplicate records by 18% and increasing overall dataset reliability for decision-making.

### Backend Team Member
**Texas Review**, Hyderabad, India | 01/2022-07/2023

• Managed and maintained backend databases handling 200+ student profiles per month for college admissions and visa applications, ensuring 100% data accuracy and compliance.

• Verified and processed 150+ client documents monthly (academic transcripts, financial statements, visa paperwork), reducing application errors by 30%.

• Utilised CRM systems to update and edit 300+ college listings, track student application status, and maintain structured records for streamlined processing.

• Generated detailed monthly performance reports (application volume, approval rates, pending cases) and presented insights to the Manager and Founder to support business decisions.

• Coordinated with cross-functional teams to resolve system and documentation issues within strict deadlines, maintaining a 95% on-time application submission rate.

### Cashier Associate
**Popina Canteen**, Vancouver, BC | 03/2025 – Present

• Managed daily cash transactions, processed card and digital payments, and handled an average of 150–250 customer transactions per shift with high accuracy.

• Maintained cash register balance at the end of shifts, ensuring 100% reconciliation between physical cash and system records.

• Provided prompt customer service by addressing billing inquiries, resolving payment discrepancies, and ensuring a smooth checkout experience.

• Assisted in inventory tracking and restocking of fast-moving items, supporting daily operations.
